preconditions.description: The number of points is between 3 and 2000, inclusive.
The coordinates of the points are within the range of -10^9 to 10^9.

preconditions.expression: All points are different and no three points lie on the same line.
preconditions.description: The points are distinct and no three points are collinear.

postconditions.expression: Output is a permutation of integers from 1 to n or -1.
postconditions.description: The output is a sequence of n distinct integers from 1 to n, or -1 if no such permutation exists.
